title: Abdominal Ultrasound of Morison Pouch with Intraperitoneal Fluid
author: Drahreg01
caption: Abdominal sonography showing free intraperitoneal fluid in Morison pouch (hepatorenal recess), demonstrating ultrasound detection of internal hemorrhage.
alt_text: Grayscale abdominal ultrasound scan showing anechoic free fluid collection between liver and kidney in Morison pouch.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates abdominal sonography for detecting intraperitoneal fluid and massive internal hemorrhage in weightlessness (CLIFF-001 Branch Baseline, p.1; Resource Table: Ultrasound machine, p.10).
